coordinates.note: Row "HR2" of the same table; longitude printed as -112.9590 W (west). Camel's Back Ridge is the name the HiRes-II ICRC 1999 paper gives to this site.

name: HiRes-II site, Camel's Back Ridge, Dugway Proving Ground

summary.plain: The second station of the HiRes cosmic-ray fluorescence detector, on Camel's Back Ridge in the Utah desert, about 13 km from the first station.
summary.technical: HiRes-II fluorescence station (42 telescope modules with FADC readout) on Camel's Back Ridge, Dugway Proving Ground, at 40.1321 N, 112.9590 W, 1552 m; in operation from spring 1999.
